Monthly Satellite Fire Detections in Australia

fire_cells.Rd

A prepared dataset of NASA FIRMS MODIS satellite-detected fire activity across Australia from September 2019 to February 2020, inclusive.

Usage

fire_cells

Format

A data frame with 2,006 rows and 4 variables:

month

Calendar month in YYYY-MM format.

cell_lon

Western longitude boundary of the grid cell, in degrees.

cell_lat

Southern latitude boundary of the grid cell, in degrees.

detections

Number of satellite detections recorded in that month and grid cell.

Source

NASA Fire Information for Resource Management System (FIRMS), MODIS active fire detections. https://firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/

Details

Individual observations are aggregated by calendar month and 1-degree latitude-longitude grid cell.

Each row represents a month and an occupied grid cell. Grid cells have equal angular dimensions but unequal physical areas, so the data should not be interpreted as an equal-area measure of fire activity.

Satellite detections do not represent unique bushfires and do not directly measure burned area or severity. Observations are subject to satellite coverage and detection conditions.
